name: com.joingiftback/giftback
title: GiftBack
description: Free, no-account Secret Santa draws, online White Elephant games, and in-budget gift finder.

tools.name: draw_secret_santa
tools.description: Run a cryptographically random Secret Santa name draw for 2–50 people with optional couple/housemate exclusions and 6-language support. Returns private per-person #fragment reveal links so neither the organizer nor the AI ever sees who drew whom.

budget.description: Optional gift budget in USD (e.g. 25 or 50).

theme.description: Optional theme (e.g. cozy, books, funny, foodie).

exclusions.description: Optional pairs of names who must not draw each other, e.g. [["Alex", "Sam"]].

language.description: Language for the private reveal pages (default "en").

tools.name: start_gift_exchange
tools.description: Generate a ready-to-share, prefilled GiftBack setup link for a full Secret Santa exchange (with wishlists from any store, private Santa-only addresses, and reminders) or an online White Elephant / Yankee Swap game — 100% free, no account or app download required.

theme.description: Optional exchange theme (e.g. cozy, books, funny).

tools.name: find_gift_ideas
tools.description: Search GiftBack’s curated catalog of 1,500+ highly rated gifts (plus optional live multi-store search across Amazon, Target, Sephora, Walmart, REI, LEGO, etc.) filtered by budget, recipient, category, age group, and things to avoid.

query.description: Keywords, recipient, or interest (e.g. "coffee lover", "for dad", "coworker").

limit.description: Number of ideas to return (default 6, max 12).

includeLive.description: Set true to also search live US retail stores.
